title: Target and Overload Workload Measurement

steps.expected_result: Scoped session established with role and permissions

steps.action: Validate secret metadata envelope under contracts schema
steps.expected_result: Schema valid, input digest computed, execution under timeout limit

steps.action: Write versioned secret payload with CAS expected_version
steps.expected_result: Fresh DEK generated, envelope written to store, plaintext transiently sealed in provider

steps.action: Obtain fresh step-up challenge token for reveal operation
steps.expected_result: Scoped step-up token issued with short TTL (120s)

steps.action: Perform authorized secret reveal with step-up verification
steps.expected_result: Provider decrypts DEK, returns transient plaintext with no-store headers
Payload rejected with INPUT_TOO_LARGE, zero allocation leak

steps.action: Dispatch request with pre-cancelled or timed-out context
steps.expected_result: Operation halts immediately with CANCELLED/TIMEOUT code

steps.action: Saturate engine with concurrent requests exceeding user limit
steps.expected_result: Engine processes bounded requests with backpressure, RSS remains strictly bounded

expected_invariants: Bounded memory and RSS under overload
Clean cancellation with zero leaked goroutines or promises
Fail closed under saturation and provider outage

negative_cases.action: Attempt to write secret larger than engine limit
Attempt to submit metadata larger than 8192 bytes
Client aborts connection during in-flight operation
Attempt reveal while provider is unreachable during peak load

execution.engine: Go engine runtime and CLI validator
